claims: 5G offers speeds up to 100x faster than 4G.
Key components of 5G include 5G New Radio (spectrum) and a cloud-native Core.
5G delivers up to 20 Gbps peak data rates.
5G NR operates on both low/mid-bands (sub-7 GHz) and high-frequency bands (mmWave, >24 GHz).
5G Core (5GC) is a cloud-native, service-based architecture.
5G includes built-in security features within its architecture.
